Hi Connor,

We're wrapping up the intake for our Winter cohort at GreenWave Labs and I wanted to reach out about Redwood's startup program. A few of our portfolio companies are evaluating inference providers and we're hoping Redwood can offer starter credits + a short trial extension for program participants so they can get through the demo day.

Specifically, one company in our cohort (see attached application) would benefit from:
- $25k in hosted credits applied to their account
- a 4-week trial extension beyond the standard 30 days

They'll be doing heavy embedding + generation during the demo period (short bursts, not sustained). If you need more info about the companies or the cohort, I can send a short list.

Any chance we can get an expedited review? Demo day is Feb 12.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for sending the application. Really excited to support the cohort.

Quick questions so I can get this routed to approvals:
1) Is the ask per company or a single credit pool for the cohort? (Your note looks per company but wanted to confirm.)
2) Can you share a rough usage estimate (monthly tokens or embedding units) for the primary company in the PDF?
3) Are any of the startups already on a paid plan or in pilot with Redwood?

We have a standard startup credit playbook but larger or multi-company requests usually need manager sign-off and a short term-sheet. Looping in Marissa for approval cadence. If it's helpful, attaching our quick checklist — it outlines what we typically need to approve credits and trial changes.

I'll aim for a 48-hour internal turnaround once I have the above.

Best,

Connor — reviewed Elena's note and the attached application. High level: happy to approve a standard incubator package for qualified applicants with the following guardrails:

- Offer: $15,000 hosted credits per company + a 3-week extension to the trial window
- Eligibility: seed-stage or pre-seed startups that are part of an accredited accelerator (GreenWave qualifies)
- Duration: credits apply for 90 days from activation; excess usage billed at standard rates thereafter

If GreenWave needs more than $15k per company (or a pooled cohort credit), we should route to Partnerships for an exception (Rishi please advise on thresholds and partner credits).

Ask Connor to confirm the company in the PDF meets the eligibility criteria and to collect a minimal usage estimate so finance can model the exposure. Once confirmed, we can send a short term-sheet and a DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
